title: Tenma Saki — Lesson From A Future Star〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi! We're all ready to practice today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm?
You sound really excited, Sakki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can you tell?
So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great. Your friends are really coming to see your show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That explains why you sound so fired up♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I totally am!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been able to sell tickets without much issue either, which leaves us plenty of time to practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We'll be able to focus on making this upcoming performance our best one yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's practice a ton and make this the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's wonderful. I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hate to rain on your parade like this, but I feel like I need to say this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's good to see that you're all motivated, and I have nothing against that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's not good to do anything special just because our friends are coming to see us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything special?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like pulling all-nighters to practice or trying to throw in a riff you've never done before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
We promise not to push ourselves like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, we're not just playing for Haruka and the others. We have a whole crowd to please!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should play in a way that makes it so they can all have fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, as long as you all understand.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That actually reminds me of something Tsukasa said. “Each performance is its own test.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Your brother performs shows for a troupe, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I think it was something his hero said during an interview this one time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “We may've done countless showings already, but this may be the first and only chance for some members of the audience to see us.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “That's why I believe each show is its own test!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were you trying to imitate your brother just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... It's close, I think...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You've captured his mannerisms rather nicely.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's really interesting. I didn't know your brother was like that, Sakki♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He's much louder than that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Louder?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. He's pretty... No, very obnoxious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I think being able to take each performance so seriously is incredibly important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Especially when you're at a time when you're still trying to get your audience to remember who you are.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By leaving a bad first impression on them, we'd have to fight tooth and nail to reverse that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which also means that we need to put on performances that people want to hear.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is awesome! I feel even more fired up than before!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Same. Why don't we get ready to start?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Luka, I'll be borrowing the drums again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Be my guest. I'll help you set them up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You still need to get tuned up, right, Ichika? Mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Actually, Miku, there's this part that I've been meaning to ask you about...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki! We can set up our stuff together♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, before that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for making sure that we won't push ourselves too hard just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We promise not to, so you have nothing to worry about♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.
